topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't escape the weight of this accusation hanging over me, not sure how to prove my innocence when every piece of evidence seems to point against me. I poured my heart into that paper, every word, every idea, genuinely believing in what I wrote. Now, it's all being questioned. I've lost count of the hours spent rewriting, trying to convince myself that maybe, just maybe, there's a way out of this mess. But the walls are closing in, and the more I try to explain, the deeper I seem to sink. What if they don't believe me? What if this changes everything?
